values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/andersonlakewest ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground', 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 13 sites 'for tent, small trailer and large trailer use', mostly shaded by large white pines. No length limit posted. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/andersonlakewest ('This more-secluded, rustic campground features 13 sites for tent, small trailer and large trailer use', 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Small gravel boat launch on Anderson Lake.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/andersonlakewest ('There are vault toilets', 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well', 'A small, gravel boat launch is located on Anderson Lake'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/andersonlakewest ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis', 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay'), read 2026-10-25

note: Secluded rustic campground near Anderson Lake, 5 mi SW of Gwinn via CR 577. Small sand swimming beach; the Anderson Lake Pathway trailhead (6 mi of loops) is in the campground. The DNR lists only this West campground (no separate 'East'). --Claude
summary: DNR page: 13 sites for tent, small and large trailer, $20/night at the kiosk + Recreation Passport (fees, previously only inherited, now on the entry), no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, gravel boat launch; first-come only, 15-day maximum (all confirmed). Season (open all year) already manual. Note trimmed of what the fields hold.
